value.name: Clean Power Alliance (CPA)
value.notes: The City of Temple City's own 'Power' page states the city joined Clean Power Alliance in December 2017 via a City Council vote.

county.notes: Temple City participates in the San Gabriel Valley Energy Wise Partnership alongside the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments, confirming its Los Angeles County / San Gabriel Valley location.

permit_authority.value: City of Temple City Building & Safety Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Temple City/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Solar PV Standard Plan (Microinverter/ACM or String Inverter Systems, as applicable)

value: Schedule the building inspection through the Building and Safety Division at (626) 656-7327
Obtain a Los Angeles County Fire Department final inspection prior to use of the PV or energy storage system installation, required for all systems

timeline_days.notes: Neither the Solar Energy System Permits page nor the SolarAPP page states a specific number of days for plan review or permit issuance.

other_conditions: PV systems limited to single-family dwellings or duplexes only
Cannot exceed the maximum building height allowed under the Zoning Ordinance
Must meet all applicable state fire, structural, electrical, and building codes as adopted or amended by the city

permit_fees.notes: The city's page states plan check fees are required upfront, payable by Visa, MasterCard, or eCheck, but no dollar amount is given.
